data.description:
## What
Write RED (failing) structural tests asserting the brainstorm replay harness exists and is registered. Create a new test file tests/skills/test-brainstorm-harness-structure.sh with two test functions.

## Why
Story f629-4fa9 DD1+DD3: structural tests must fail before the harness is created, then pass once it exists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- New test file tests/skills/test-brainstorm-harness-structure.sh created and executable
- Function `test_harness_directory_exists` asserts tests/brainstorm/ directory exists with at least one test runner file (test-*.sh); FAILS before harness creation (RED)
- Function `test_runner_registration` asserts that tests/brainstorm is listed in commands.test_dirs entry of .claude/dso-config.conf; FAILS before registration (RED)
- Test file uses REPO_ROOT=/Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/worktree-20260506-141557 pattern for path resolution
- Tests follow pass/fail pattern of existing test files in tests/skills/
- .test-index updated to add mapping: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-harness-structure.sh → plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/ (or appropriate source)

## Files to Modify
- tests/skills/test-brainstorm-harness-structure.sh (CREATE)
- .test-index (add entry)

## testing_mode
RED
